description: Unit tests for the VAAPI video encode accelerator, specifically testing initialization and encoding sequences for VP9 with multiple spatial and temporal layers, using mock objects to simulate VAAPI wrapper behavior.

classes.name: MockVideoEncodeAcceleratorClient
classes.description: Mock implementation of the VideoEncodeAccelerator::Client interface for testing.

classes.name: MockVaapiWrapper
classes.description: Mock implementation of the VaapiWrapper class to simulate VAAPI interactions.

classes.name: MockVP9VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate
classes.description: Mock implementation of the VP9VaapiVideoEncoderDelegate for testing.

classes.name: VaapiVideoEncodeAcceleratorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for VAAPI video encode accelerator tests, including setup, mock configuration, and encoding sequence tests.

methods.description: Resets and reinitializes the encoder with mock VAAPI wrapper and delegate.
